Una casa di famiglia. Una nuova storia d: A family home. A new story to share.
Dai Squee nasce dalla casa di Martin e G: Dai Squee began as the home of Martin and Gigetta, in the heart of Possagno. Its name preserves a family memory: 'Squee', meaning bowls, was the old nickname of the maternal family of their grandson, Massimo.
È lui ad aver dedicato tre anni di energ: Massimo devoted three years of energy and care to the renovation. His aim was to bring these rooms back to life, preserve their connection to the family and village, and welcome visitors to this corner of Veneto.
Oggi la casa accoglie tre appartamenti d: Today the house holds three different apartments, sharing a simple idea of hospitality: independence, peace and the pleasure of feeling at ease. A base for discovering Canova's art, walking through the hills or simply taking time to slow down.
